# Session format fixtures

These are synthetic, anonymized reproductions of shapes inspected read-only in
licitaBot CHG-12.2 on 2026-11-03. No original prompts, paths, ids or outputs are copied.
The Codex child repeats parent calls and usage before its creation time; its cwd is
outside the task workspace. A script-completed text block does not supply a command
exit code. The nested execution envelope is a separately supported result shape.
